tasks.objective:
Implement the REPORT DESIGN work the PO explicitly reopened as N24, coordinated with the still separate N23 footer/signature identity. Do not overtake the current N71 and N100 delivery-completeness tasks: the declared dependencies require their verified delivery/closure first. Older N58 and N36 have distinct unavailable live/official-surface gates and must not cause unrelated approved work to idle forever; do not repeat or bypass those actions. This card does not activate any other deferred/FROZEN item, N93 study, N78 admin or student portal.
Use the current actual report surfaces and shared src/lib/report-print.js. The PO wants quieter Rakeez branding, cleaner report design, no duplicated information, a compact useful header with fewer coordinated lines, sensible table density and footer/signature alignment. This is a real coherent design pass, not renaming one label and closing the whole overhaul. Preserve every report's data contract, calculation, filter, export fields, user-selected scope and current student ordering. Before changing, inventory only the listed existing report surfaces and render a small representative set from synthetic data; reuse their current data generators rather than copy formulas or import account data.
After implementation inspect real app screenshots AND generated print/PDF page renders, not only text/CSS selectors. Return a concise before/after evidence map and the exact surfaces changed; identify any unfinished N24 scope honestly. Sole publisher handles Product deployment after the affected functional/visual checks. Await PO acceptance of appearance; do not close N23/N24 automatically from this task or claim the user reviewed it.
acceptance: Apply a shared report presentation across actual grades, attendance/detailed attendance, support/achievement where present, execution and cross-class reports. Preserve their distinct purposes and all selected data rather than forcing them into one inaccurate template. Use existing Rakeez typography/assets and calm brand color in small accents; no new external fonts, oversized logo, ornamental content or user identifiers. Keep teacher/school/term/subject/class/date information only when relevant and already available; never fabricate values or print account email/technical Sync messages.

Compact aligned RTL header, reduce duplicated headings/identity/date lines, preserve legibility instead of forcing tiny text. Maintain actual selected range and approved central date format/picker, Latin digits policy and official names. Footer/signatures have stable spacing/alignment and appear only where the existing report needs them. Keep N23's separate identity and report exactly what related footer work this N24 pass covers.

Actual A4 portrait and landscape output as appropriate: table headings repeat on multi-page data, no cut-off student/subject names or overlapping labels, no horizontally lost columns, no blank trailing page caused by signatures, and no notice/toolbars/buttons printed. Preserve legible black-and-white printing as well as screen mode. Use a representative small report and a multi-page fixture including long Arabic labels. Render the generated PDF to page images with an existing available renderer and inspect them; browser print-media screenshot alone is not proof of pagination. No OCR or document-authoring replacement of the app's actual export path.

Use real report DOM, handlers and existing data sources with synthetic students and deliberately distinct grades/attendance. Compare IDs, row order, numeric totals and export columns before/after. This presentation change must not alter scoring, roster identities, filtering, CSV/XLSX values, print authorization or closed-term histories. Preserve N49 print-notice exclusion. No live school account, Auth, RLS, SQL, notification delivery or automatic Noor writing.

At desktop and narrow320/390px screens, report controls remain reachable, labels wrap gracefully and dense table views can use the existing deliberate overflow pattern without breaking the page. No +/− controls reintroduced to the overall grade table, no changed subitem cycles or statuses. Scope styles to report surfaces rather than globally restyling the teacher app.

Run only related report/print/data invariants and representative visual checks, not all Product suites or live fixtures. Include sw.js registration only if a new required style/module is introduced, following the current cache version convention. A permitted stylesheet registration in app.js may not change account/Sync boot logic. Reuse unchanged data tests while input/source is unchanged.
